idea.title: Commit Message Coach for Student Repos
idea.pitch: A CLI that scores your commit messages and suggests clearer rewrites before you push.
idea.problem_solved: Students push vague commit messages that make their history unreadable to reviewers.
idea.target_users: CS students preparing GitHub profiles for internship applications.

milestones.title: Parse commits
milestones.description: Read the last 20 commits from a local repo and print them.

milestones.title: Score messages
milestones.description: Apply rule-based scoring and print a score per commit.

milestones.title: Suggest rewrites
milestones.description: Call the LLM for a rewrite and show a diff.

milestones.title: Ship the hook
milestones.description: Install as a commit-msg hook and publish to PyPI.

idea.portfolio_tip: Record a 20-second terminal GIF for the README and link the PyPI page on your resume.
